Hi all — quick notes from prep for the working session tomorrow.

1) Nightly eval: our standard flow is to run the eval harness in Redwood's batch runner and publish a JSON summary to a signed S3 path. We can also POST alerts to a webhooks endpoint — we support both. Webhook is trivial to enable; we'll need an endpoint and an HMAC secret from your side.

2) Regression alerts: we recommend a two-tier approach:
   - Tier 1 (warning): delta >= 6% absolute drop in pass-rate for a critical prompt group OR any new safety/policy hit.
   - Tier 2 (critical): delta >= 12% absolute drop OR >2 consecutive nightly runs below threshold. Tier 2 triggers auto-canary and notification to oncall.

3) Canary + rollback recipe (proposed):
   - Canary scope: 5% of production traffic, 15 minute ramp with monitoring windows.
   - Failure signals to trigger rollback: Tier 2 alert OR sustained latency degradation >40% at p95 AND error rate >1%.
   - On rollback: immediate routing to human triage queue + fallback model (smaller quantized v1.3) for 100% of canary traffic; full rollback if error persists for 20 minutes.

4) Acceptance criteria for pilot: nightly pass-rate >= 92% across critical prompt group and no Tier 2 alerts for 7 consecutive nights.

I attached a sample alerts template (regression-alerts-sample.yaml) you can use to wire your incident system. We'll firm these thresholds in the session.

Lauren Bishop
Platform QA Engineer, Redwood Inference
